summary: AE Studio, in collaboration with Anthropic, introduces GRAM, a training method that isolates dangerous knowledge into switchable auxiliary modules within a single model, tested on models from 50M to 5B parameters, with results not yet applied to production Anthropic models.

practices.reason: Describes a method for controlling access to dual-use model capabilities that a safety/security team could evaluate as an alternative to classifiers and tiered deployment.
practices.quote: An alternative approach is access control at the level of individual capabilities. For example, a deployment that includes advanced virology knowledge for a vetted biosecurity lab and excludes it everywhere else, with general performance unchanged in both cases.

practices.reason: GRAM is a training-time technique for module isolation, described concretely with reported gains but at small-to-medium scale and not applied to production models.
practices.quote: This research is preliminary and has not been applied to production models at Anthropic.
